QuestInfo.0: Jay has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: Jay has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.2: Jay has a gift for you.

0.msg: Good, you're here. I've got something special for you this time. Honestly, this took effort, even for me--but it paid off.

1.msg: A #b#t1191001##k?... So you really do care, Jay. I love it.

2.msg: And it's made of hypoallergenic metal! So you have no excuse not to use it.

no.0: You can just tell me if you don't want it, you know. You don't have to keep leaving it behind like this.

yes.0: Be careful you don't lose that, it would be a nightmare to replace.

default.0: You don't have enough to cover the cost of remaking it.
